Source: Higher doses of intravenous rifampicin may improve outcomes in tuberculous meningitis but are impractical in high-burden settings.
Luganda: Doozi ennene eza rifampicin ayisibwa mu misuwa ziyinza okulongoosa ebivaamu mu tuberculous meningitis naye tezisobola kuweebwa mu bifo ebirimu abalwadde abangi ennyo.
Yoruba: Ó ṣe é ṣe kí ìwọ̀n púpọ̀ abẹ́rẹ́- rifamupisín-nì-ìn tí a gún gba inú-iṣan mú kí abàjáde ìtọ́jú ìkọ́-fée gbèrú ṣùgbọ́n ó wọ́pọ̀ ní àwọn agbègbè tí kò ti sí owó.
Zulu: Umthamo ophezulu we-rifampicin emthanjeni ungase uthuthukise imiphumela ye-meningitis yesifo sofuba kodwa awulungiselelwa ukusetshenziswa ezimeni zomthwalo omkhulu.
Hausa: Yawan allurai na rifampicin na cikin jijiya fiye da ƙima yana iya inganta sakamako a cikin cutar sanƙarau na ƙwaƙwalwa amma ba su da amfani a cikin wurare masu nauyi.

Source: We hypothesized that plasma rifampicin exposures would be similar between oral dosing of 35 mg/kg of body weight and intravenous dosing of 20 mg/kg, which has been proposed for efficacy trials in tuberculous meningitis.
Luganda: Twateebereza nti rifampicin ayingira mu mazzi g’omu musaayi ajja kuba afaanana wakati wa doozi ey’omu kamwa eya 35 mg/kg ey’obuzito bw’omubiri ne doozi y’omu misuwa eya mg/kg, nga zino ze zaateesebwa mu kugezesa kw’enkola y’eddagala lino mu tuberculous meningitis.
Yoruba: A fi lélẹ̀ pé gbígba rifamupisín-nì-ìn yóò fi ara pẹ́láàárín ìwọ̀n lílò láti ẹnu fún mílígramù sí ìwọn títóbi 35 mg/kg, bẹ́ẹ̀ si ni fífúnu láti inú iṣan yóò jẹ́ ìwọn mílígramù sí ìwọn títóbi 20mg/kg, èyí tí a ti fi lílẹ̀ fún ìgbìyànjú fún ìtọ́jú ikọ́ ife tó nípa.

Hausa: Mun yi hasashen cewa bayyanar rifampicin na plasma zai kasance iri ɗaya a tsakanin alluran baka na 35 mg/kg na nauyin jiki da kuma allurai na 20 mg/kg na cikin jijiya, wanda aka bayar da shawara don ingantaccen gwaji a cikin ciwon sanƙarau na ƙwaƙwalwa.

Northern Sotho: Morago ga moo banyakišiši ba etše ka moo rifampicin e bego e hwetšagala go polasma ya madi a bona (karolo ya seela sa madi).

Source: It is hoped that such treatment will save more lives of people in Africa and in other areas of the world where tuberculosis meningitis is a major problem.

Hausa: Ana fatan irin wannan maganin zai ceci rayukan mutane da dama a Afirka da ma sauran sassan duniya da cutar sanƙarau na ƙwaƙwalwa ya zama matsala babba.
Northern Sotho: Go hutša gore kalafo ya mohuta woo e tla boloka maphelo a batho a bantši ka Afrika le ka dikarolong tše dingwe tša lefase moo menatšaetisi ya go ruruga ga lera la bjoko e lego bothata bjo bogolo.
Amharic: እንዲህ ያለው ህክምና የሳንባ ነቀርሳ ማጅራት ገትር በሽታ ዋነኛ ችግር በሆነባቸው በአፍሪካ እና በሌሎች የአለም አካባቢዎች የብዙ ሰዎችን ህይወት ይታደገዋል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
